        17                  THE SECRETARY:    By Senator

        18       Perkins, Legislative Resolution Number 994,

        19       memorializing Governor Andrew M. Cuomo to

        20       proclaim March 2011 as Colorectal Cancer

        21       Awareness Month in the State of New York.

        22                  "WHEREAS, Colorectal cancer is the

        23       second leading cause of cancer deaths in men

        24       and women combined in the United States; and

        25                  "WHEREAS, It is estimated that in



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                                         1512



         1       the year 2011 over 146,970 new cases of

         2       colorectal cancer will be diagnosed in the

         3       United States; and

         4                  "WHEREAS, In the year 2011 the

         5       disease is expected to kill an estimated

         6       49,920 individuals in this country; and

         7                  "WHEREAS, An estimated 9,970

         8       individuals in the State of New York were

         9       diagnosed with colorectal cancer in the year

        10       2009; and

        11                  "WHEREAS, In November of 1999 the

        12       United States Senate passed legislation

        13       declaring March 2000 as the first ever

        14       National Colorectal Cancer Awareness Month;

        15       and

        16                  "WHEREAS, The Colon Cancer

        17       Alliance, Inc., will continue working with

        18       Congress for coverage, education, and

        19       awareness so that colorectal cancer is

        20       detected early and lives are saved; and

        21                  "WHEREAS, Screening for colorectal

        22       cancer is underutilized.  Less than 50 percent

        23       of individuals above age 50 receive annual

        24       screenings for colorectal cancer; and

        25                  "WHEREAS, Regular screenings, which



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                                         1513



         1       can detect polyps that lead to colorectal

         2       cancer, can save lives; and

         3                  "WHEREAS, Education can help inform

         4       the public about methods of prevention, and

         5       about symptoms, to aid in early detection; and

         6                  "WHEREAS, Adopting a healthy diet

         7       at a young age can significantly reduce the

         8       risk of developing colorectal cancer; and

         9                  "WHEREAS, The Ralph Lauren Center

        10       for Cancer Care and Prevention is offering

        11       colon cancer evaluations for men and women

        12       age 50 and over, and prostate evaluations for

        13       men age 40 and over, to be held at the Adam

        14       Clayton Powell Jr. State Office Building in

        15       New York on Wednesday, March 23, 2011, in

        16       conjunction with Colorectal Cancer Awareness

        17       Month in the State of New York; and

        18                  "WHEREAS, The State of New York

        19       should help inform the public about colorectal

        20       cancer prevention and screening; now,

        21       therefore, be it

        22                  "RESOLVED, That this Legislative

        23       Body pause in its deliberations to memorialize

        24       Governor Andrew M. Cuomo to proclaim

        25       March 2011 as Colorectal Cancer Awareness



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       Month in the State of New York; and be it

         2       further

         6       the State of New York; The Colon Cancer

        21                  SENATOR PERKINS:    Thank you very

        22       much.

        23                  I'm going to be brief because I

        24       think that the resolution speaks well for what

        25       it is that we're trying to acknowledge.



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                                         1515



         1                  I'm speaking today as a survivor of

         2       colorectal cancer, and I know all too well

         3       that early detection is essential.  However,

         4       less than 50 percent of at-risk individuals

         5       have regular screenings.  Colorectal cancer is

         6       highly treatable with early detection, and if

         7       everyone at risk received screenings

         8       regularly, the number of deaths could be

         9       reduced by 60 percent.

        10                  And I know especially

        11       African-American men and men of color are

        12       often victims of colorectal cancer to the

        13       fatal extent.  And we've launched a campaign

        14       to alert our neighbors and our friends to get

        15       these prescreenings in order to prevent the

        16       mortality that would result without them.  As

        17       a matter of fact, as was pointed out, we are

        18       doing some screenings as we speak at the Adam

        19       Clayton Powell State Office Building.

        20                  And I want to acknowledge again the

        21       Ralph Lauren Center for Cancer Care and

        22       Prevention for the extraordinary work that

        23       they've been doing in alerting our communities

        24       about this colorectal cancer problem and

        25       getting the community united and organized to



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                                         1516



         1       deal with it.

         2                  So thank you very much, and I would

         3       ask my colleagues to join me in signing onto

         4       the resolution.
